title: nginx and Docker Compose for deployment; what to prepare for production
decision: The proxy is nginx and the application is run with Docker Compose, where the approved architecture names Caddy. The founder also chose what to prepare before production: deployment files, the backup schedule and restore test, security findings 9 and 11 to 13, reassigning ownership and rotating the server secret, and a test of the front end and back end together; and to remove merged worktrees, branches and test databases
context: Answered by the founder on 2026-10-07 when asked by the agent in the working session
rationale: The founder chose it when asked; the architecture document still says Caddy and is to be amended by him
